sections.heading: Overview of Christchurch Gym Market
sections.body: The Christchurch gym market is highly competitive, with a range of options to suit different budgets and preferences. City Fitness is the largest player, with multiple locations across the city, including in the CBD, Riccarton, and Papanui. Other popular gyms in Christchurch include Les Mills, Anytime Fitness, and Jetts.

sections.heading: Post-Quake Rebuild of Christchurch Gyms
sections.body: The Christchurch earthquakes had a devastating impact on the city's gym scene, with many facilities destroyed or damaged. However, in recent years, there has been a significant rebuild of gym facilities, with many new and improved gyms opening across the city. City Fitness, for example, has invested heavily in new equipment and facilities at its CBD and Riccarton locations.
